Constraint: A week satisfies the constraint if its implied finish time is within 50 seconds of the target time; a difference of exactly 50 seconds satisfies it. A week violates it if the difference is more than 50 seconds.

Verdict: violated

Comments: The plan violates the constraint because at least one week has an implied finish time outside of the allowed range; Week 2 has an implied finish time that rounds up to 5 minutes per km, which when multiplied by 10 km gives a finish time far beyond the target time.
